channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Goldman strategist adds data to earnings-bubble warning
item.description: Peter Oppenheimer, who flagged the risk that AI stocks were riding an unsustainable earnings boom this summer, has done more math.

item.title: Crypto.com founder says crypto battles will continue but war is over
item.description: After years of championing the Clarity Act framework, the founder said Tuesday's result is a setback, but the war has already been fought.

item.title: Grads in AI-exposed majors since 2022 turn to retail and food service
item.description: Entry-level hiring declined after ChatGPT, and graduates in those fields are settling for lower-paying service work instead of white-collar jobs.

item.title: Top AI developers urge caution; Congress pressed to act
item.description: Current law mandates incident reporting, a point often overlooked.
